text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The International Monetary Fund has given the green light for international donors to fund Zimbabwe's second phase of economic reforms following two weeks of intensive discussions with the government.

- South Africa's amendment to a proposal by Zimbabwe, Botswana and Namibia for a CITES ban on ivory trade to be lifted on Tuesday fell short of just three votes to the two-thirds majority required for it to pass.
- The High Court will on Wednesday morning hand down judgement in the ritual murder trial of a businessman and two other suspects.
- An eleven-year-old boy who took his father's pistol to school with the intention of scaring off a fellow pupil has been expelled, a regional education director said on Tuesday.
